tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account's business name and website, its data timezone, how far back data is available, and reference values (conversion event types, device type codes). Call this first.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Headline numbers for a date range: page views (all, and excluding bots), unique visitors, new visitors, conversions, conversion rate and event counts by type. These match the Tagely analytics page. Set compare_to_previous to also get the preceding period.

tools.name: get_breakdown
tools.description: Top values of one dimension for a date range, for visitors and for conversions - the same breakdowns as the Tagely analytics page. url: page views (excluding bots) grouped by URL without query string; conversions not available for url. utm / referer / country / device: visitor counts are new visitor

tools.name: list_views
tools.description: Individual page view rows for a date range, newest first, with optional filters. Bots excluded unless include_bots is true. Visitor IP addresses are not included.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Individual event rows (leads, purchases, subscriptions etc.) for a date range, newest first, each with the URL of the page it fired on. args holds the event's own data (e.g. purchase value), decoded from JSON where possible.

tools.name: get_visitor_journey
tools.description: Every view and event recorded for one visitor (up to 500 of each), in time order, as a single timeline. Get visitor_id values from list_views or list_events.
